reviews.body:
### 🔵 Needs a closer look A maintainer must confirm the replacement model IDs against current Groq and OpenRouter offerings because provider listings and live endpoint support could not be independently verified. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Updates PyRIT’s Groq and OpenRouter configuration examples to replace retired model IDs, keeping the environment template and getting-started guide aligned. **Changes:** - Replaces the Groq example with `openai/gpt-oss-20b`. - Replaces the OpenRouter example with `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`. - Preserves variable names and leaves existing user configurations and application code unchanged. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `doc/​getting_started/​populating_secrets.md` | Updates both provider model IDs in setup examples. | | `.env_example` | Updates the corresponding Groq and OpenRouter model values. |
Review effort: Balanced
